sentence: He may well being right about the price.
ruleVi: May well + động từ nguyên mẫu = rất có thể.

sentence: The shop is closed, so we might as well to cook at home.
ruleVi: Might as well + động từ nguyên mẫu không to.

sentence: With that low price, the phone is bound selling out.
ruleVi: Be bound + to-V = chắc chắn sẽ.

sentence: I could hardly believed my eyes when I saw the result.
ruleVi: Could hardly + động từ nguyên mẫu.

sentence: It's late, so we might as good go home.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định might as well = chẳng còn cách nào hơn.

sentence: She may well has forgotten our meeting.
ruleVi: Sau may well là nguyên mẫu: may well have + V3.

sentence: He could hard walk after the long hike.
ruleVi: Could hardly = hầu như không thể; hard là 'chăm chỉ/khó'.

sentence: If nobody else wants the cake, I might well as eat it.
ruleVi: Trật tự cố định: might as well.

sentence: Traffic is bound be terrible during Tết.
Prices are binding to rise after the new tax.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định be bound to = chắc chắn sẽ.
